roles.use_summary: Annotated gene lists with biomaRt2.60.1 in neuronal Cfh-cKO culture RNA-seq analysis.
roles.implementation_scope_note: The exact annotation attributes,query and Ensembl release are unspecified; preserve supplied gene-list IDs and species rather than assuming transcript quantification or a nearest-gene model.

roles.use_summary: Used biomaRt when excluding mitochondrial,ribosomal and X/Y chromosome genes from the sexual-dimorphism pathway analysis.
roles.implementation_scope_note: This is annotation-based gene exclusion,not RNA-seq transcript import. Exact filtering lists and annotation release remain to be recovered; KEGG/WikiPathways enrichment through DOSE/clusterProfiler is separate.

roles.use_summary: Used biomaRt together with kallisto0.44.0 and tximport for GRCh38 mRNA/ncRNA gene-expression quantification from PLATE-seq drug-perturbation libraries.
roles.implementation_scope_note: Exact annotation queries,release and mapping are unspecified; importing an existing transcript-to-gene TSV does not implement biomaRt.

roles.use_summary: Filtered hypothyroid/cis-eQTL colocalization results to protein-coding genes according to gene IDs using the biomaRt R package.
roles.implementation_scope_note: Gene-biotype annotation/filtering is separate from colocalization inference; exact Ensembl release and query settings are unspecified.

roles.use_summary: Assigned Ensembl identifiers to gene symbols with biomaRt for short-read RNA-seq differential-expression analysis using edgeR.
roles.implementation_scope_note: ID-to-symbol mapping is separate from edgeR testing. The source does not specify one-to-many mapping resolution or annotation release; retain original IDs rather than silently merging symbols.

roles.use_summary: Downloaded Ensembl gene-ontology terms for each query and control gene through biomaRt.
roles.implementation_scope_note: Term retrieval is separate from downstream GO testing and the query/control background. Preserve annotation release,term identities and multiple-mapping decisions; no automatic enrichment choice is established.

roles.use_summary: Annotated the closest gene for GWAS results using Ensembl GRCh37 BioMart through the biomaRt package.
roles.implementation_scope_note: Preserve the declared GRCh37 coordinates. The exact closest-gene distance/tie rule and annotation release are not specified; this is not transcript import or evidence of a generic gene-window equivalence.
